shots.at: At the start of the twentieth century
shots.prompt: A busy 1905 machine shop, rows of belt-driven lathes under overhead line shafts and leather belts, machinists in flat caps and aprons, dusty sunbeams through tall factory windows

shots.at: But the tool itself kept failing
shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of a lathe cutting tool pressed against a spinning steel bar, the tip of the tool glowing dull red from heat, a blue curling chip and tiny sparks, dark background
A tired machinist in a flat cap and leather apron sharpening a worn tool bit on a large grinding wheel, sparks flying, 1905 workshop, frustrated expression

shots.at: Then an inventor in a small town in Indiana
shots.prompt: A small Indiana town street around 1905 at dusk, brick storefronts, a lit workshop window glowing warm where an inventor works late

shots.at: It was a metal with almost no iron
And when it was heated to a dull red
shots.title: AT A DULL RED HEAT

shots.at: He named it after the stars
shots.prompt: A polished silvery metal bar on a wooden workbench reflecting a clear night sky full of bright stars seen through an open workshop window, quiet and magical

shots.at: But it never really went away

shots.prompt: A glowing star-shaped spark above an old belt-driven lathe in a dark workshop, dramatic rim light, mysterious mood
